Qt 5.15.2

LocalAudio's native settings and tutorial bridge dynamically links to Qt Core,
Qt Gui and Qt Widgets 5.15.2. These Qt modules are available under the GNU Lesser
General Public License version 3, with the GNU General Public License version 3
incorporated as described in that license. Qt copyright remains with The Qt
Company and the other copyright holders identified in the Qt source files.

The Qt libraries are supplied by the installed TeamSpeak client. LocalAudio's
independent installer does not distribute Qt library binaries or modify them.
Copies of LGPLv3 and GPLv3 are provided in Qt-LGPL-3.0.txt and Qt-GPL-3.0.txt.

Qt 5.15.2 source:
https://download.qt.io/archive/qt/5.15/5.15.2/single/qt-everywhere-src-5.15.2.tar.xz
https://github.com/qt/qtbase/tree/v5.15.2

The LocalAudio bridge source is in audio/src/denoise_qt_ui.cpp and
native-ui/CMakeLists.txt. BUILDING.md describes building the bridge and plugin.
A build generates its own resource manifests and integrity values, so modified
bridge binaries can be used with a matching locally built plugin and bundle.
LocalAudio's terms do not restrict the modification, relinking or reverse
engineering needed to exercise rights granted by the LGPL.

Qt LGPL information:
https://www.qt.io/development/open-source-lgpl-obligations
